type UncorrelatedShape = {kind:"text";value:string}|{kind:"count";value:number};
function mutablePattern(shape: UncorrelatedShape) {
  let {kind, value} = shape;
  if (kind === "text") value.toUpperCase();
}
function separatePatterns(shape: UncorrelatedShape) {
  const {kind} = shape;
  const {value} = shape;
  if (kind === "text") value.toUpperCase();
}
function restTypeMismatch(...[n, s]: [number,string]) {
  return s.toFixed();
}
function assignedParameter({kind, value}: UncorrelatedShape) {
  if (kind === "text") value.toUpperCase();
  value = "assigned";
}
